label: v187
changes: Scanned documents are now read properly — all of them, not one page in nine. Teluva was handing your whole PDF to Google to unpack, and on a nine-page lease Google managed exactly one page and rejected the other eight. Teluva now prepares each page itself before sending it, and the same lease reads front to back.

Ask in your own words, get the clause anyway. If nothing in the document contains the words you typed, Teluva now looks for the parts that are about what you asked instead of shrugging. Ask about an electrician and you get the repair and maintenance clauses — clearly labelled as related rather than as matches, so you know which is which.

A page with text and a page that's a photo can now live in the same document. Teluva reads the text pages as text and the scanned pages as pictures, instead of giving up on the whole file because one page happened to have a text layer.
